fullnameOverride.description: Override the generated names for chart-owned resources. Leave empty to use chart defaults.

global.description: Global values are populated by the Drive platform during deployment and by drv during local development. Users do not need to set them manually.

systemName.description: Drive system identifier supplied by the delivery platform.

stageName.description: Stage identifier supplied by the delivery platform.

verticalId.description: Drive vertical identifier supplied by the delivery platform.

domain.description: Base domain used by platform-managed routes and integrations.

registry.description: Container image registry prefix supplied by the delivery platform.

drive-system-lib.description: Internal values namespace for the drive-system-lib dependency; not intended for chart consumers.

otel.description: Controls OpenTelemetry export configuration for all app workloads.

enabled.description: Enable app telemetry export to the platform node collector.

secrets.description: Names of platform-managed secrets to expose to this system as ExternalSecrets. Secret values are not supplied in chart values.

appDefaults.description: Default container port, probe port, and resource requests/limits inherited by apps unless overridden per app.

containerPort.description: Default port exposed by each app container and Service.

probes.description: Default probe port for app workloads.

port.description: Default port used by shorthand HTTP readiness and liveness probes.

resources.description: Default Kubernetes container resource requests and limits inherited by apps without an app-level override.

apps.description: Application workloads keyed by app name. Each key becomes the workload and service name.

profile.description: Runtime profile used for profile-specific workload behavior. `java` selects Java security identity and enables a default startup probe when a liveness path is configured.

tag.description: Container image tag for this app. Required; the image repository is derived from the app name and global registry.

replicaCount.description: Fixed Deployment replica count when autoscaling is not configured. Defaults to 1; set 0 to scale down.

autoscaling.description: Configure a HorizontalPodAutoscaler instead of a fixed replica count.

minReplicas.description: Minimum number of app replicas maintained by the autoscaler.

maxReplicas.description: Maximum number of app replicas maintained by the autoscaler.

targetCpuPercent.description: Target average CPU utilization percentage used for autoscaling.

containerPort.description: Port exposed by the app container and its Kubernetes Service.

httpGateway.description: Enable platform HTTP routes for the app. Each enabled exposure creates a route at /<app-name>.

public.description: Expose this app through the public HTTP gateway.

gated.description: Expose this app through the gated HTTP gateway.

private.description: Expose this app through the private HTTP gateway.

extraEgress.description: Additional Cilium egress rules for this app, using CiliumNetworkPolicy rule fields. `toSystems` is a chart-specific shorthand for another Drive system. See the [Cilium network policy documentation](https://docs.cilium.io/en/stable/security/policy/).

extraIngress.description: Additional Cilium ingress rules for this app. `fromSystems` is a chart-specific shorthand for another Drive system. See the [Cilium network policy documentation](https://docs.cilium.io/en/stable/security/policy/).

strategy.description: Optional Kubernetes Deployment strategy override. See the [Kubernetes Deployment API](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/kubernetes-api/workload-resources/deployment-v1/#DeploymentSpec).

resources.description: Kubernetes container resource requests and limits. Replaces appDefaults.resources when set.

env.description: Additional environment variables with literal string values.

secretEnv.description: Environment variables sourced from existing Kubernetes Secrets, keyed by environment variable name.

secretName.description: Name of the existing Kubernetes Secret containing the environment variable value.

secretKey.description: Key within the Secret to expose as the environment variable value.

probes.description: Readiness, liveness, and startup probes. Full Kubernetes probe objects override the shorthand HTTP paths.

port.description: Port used by shorthand HTTP readiness and liveness probes; defaults to appDefaults.probes.port.

readiness.description: HTTP path for a generated readiness probe. Overridden by readinessProbe when provided.

liveness.description: HTTP path for a generated liveness probe and, for Java apps, the default startup probe. Overridden by livenessProbe for liveness.

readinessProbe.description: Full Kubernetes readinessProbe object; takes precedence over the readiness path.

livenessProbe.description: Full Kubernetes livenessProbe object; takes precedence over the liveness path.

startup.description: Optional full Kubernetes startupProbe object. For Java apps, replaces the default startup probe derived from the liveness path.

volumeMounts.description: Mount existing Secrets/ConfigMaps or emptyDir volumes. Only these chart-supported volume types are accepted.

ephemeralDirs.description: Named emptyDir volumes for writable ephemeral storage in the otherwise read-only app container.

path.description: Absolute path inside the container where the emptyDir volume is mounted.

secrets.description: Existing Kubernetes Secrets mounted as volumes, keyed by Secret name.

configMap.description: Existing Kubernetes ConfigMaps mounted as volumes, keyed by ConfigMap name.

extraContainers.description: Additional Kubernetes Container objects added to the app Pod. See the [Kubernetes Container API](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/kubernetes-api/workload-resources/pod-v1/#Container).

postgres.description: PostgreSQL connection bindings for databases provisioned separately, typically by drive-system-postgres.

bindings.description: Database connections to inject as app environment variables. Each binding targets a cluster and database resource.

name.description: Binding name used to derive the app's PostgreSQL connection environment variable.

clusterRef.description: Key of the PostgreSQL cluster in the PostgreSQL chart's clusters map.

databaseRef.description: Key of the database within the referenced PostgreSQL cluster.

secretName.description: Override the generated database credential Secret name. Defaults to the established name for the db/default binding, otherwise <clusterRef>-<databaseRef>.

nats.description: Enable NATS access for this app. It connects to the account named by global.systemName.

user.description: Configure access controls for this app's NATS identity.

permissions.description: Configure subject access and request reply behavior for this app's NATS user.

path.description: Absolute container path where the existing Secret or ConfigMap is mounted.

optional.description: Allow the pod to start if the Secret or ConfigMap does not exist. Defaults to false.
